app_fee.value: International applicants pay a $75 nonrefundable application fee; domestic applicants pay $45.
app_fee.quote: $45 for domestic applicants and $75 for international applicants

fee_waiver.value: BGSU does not give international applicants application fee waivers on request.
fee_waiver.quote: we are unable to provide application fee waivers upon request

gre_general.value: The Graduate College does not require GRE scores; individual programs may, so see each program record.

toefl_min.value: For 2026 and later admissions the Graduate College minimum is TOEFL iBT 4 on the new scale.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate College minimum is an IELTS score of 6.5.

english_waiver.value: The exemption covers applicants from countries where instruction is in English; India is not named, so the rule does not settle an English-medium degree from India.

also.quote: Are from, or earned a degree from, a country in which instruction was delivered in English

notes: TOEFL and IELTS minimums are the Graduate College's; the 2025-and-before TOEFL rule (80, old scale) no longer applies to Fall 2027.
